name: @salesteer/crypto-core
description: Browser-native cryptographic primitives and vault key management for Salesteer applications.

scripts.clean: node --eval "import('node:fs').then(({ rmSync }) => rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.prerelease: pnpm lint:fix && pnpm format && pnpm build && pnpm test:coverage
scripts.release:patch: pnpm prerelease && pnpm version patch && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: pnpm prerelease && pnpm version minor && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: pnpm prerelease && pnpm version major && git push --follow-tags
